ابتكروا (form VIII)

# اُبْتُكِرُوا (ubtukirū) /ub.tu.ki.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِبْتَكَرَ (ibtakara)
# اِبْتَكِرُوا (ibtakirū) /ib.ta.ki.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِبْتَكَرَ (ibtakara)
